text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while working in my office
during the
holiday season...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer? You don't get presents
from Santa
anymore, right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thought so. That's a shame, though.
You'd be on
the good list for sure.
choice_data_list: Well... you're an adult, after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But don't worry. I was thinking this year I'll be your Santa and get you a nice present!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So you just look forward to the big day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the eve of the "big day" arrives.
I follow
Oguri Cap's instructions and
make my way to the
meeting place.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Happy holidays. Let's have a great day
together.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Mayano said that if I'm going out
for the holidays, I should wear
something extra special.
And she told
me all about what grown-ups do.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And how the most important present is
the
memories you make together.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So, today, just leave everything to me,
because I
want to give you the best
present of all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that Mayano Top Gun had a
hand in this
is... concerning... but I know
Oguri Cap's just excited for the holiday
and presents, so I'm sure it'll be a fun
day.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
We'll have all of whatever you
recommend.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff
text_block_list.text: Oh, um... Okay... Coming right up...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Now we're set. So, what do you think,
Trainer?
Your heart must be pounding!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mayano said I should try and get your
heart
pounding. So, this is the idea I
came up with.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If you let the staff choose your order,
there's no
telling what they'll bring.
Exciting, right?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hamburger steak, curry, omelet rice... Maybe even gratin or spaghetti... Who knows what's on the way? Ahh, but I can't wait to find out... Drool...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Take a look. It's the Winter Crab Fair.
And every
single one of them looks
gorgeous and delicious.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Of course I like crab, but more
importantly, Mayano said we should go
window shopping and
enjoy something
seasonal.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: This time of year is crab season, right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... That would be amazing right
now. But we're supposed to be window
shopping. Mayano didn't say anything in
her advice about
purchasing stuff.
choice_data_list: True, that sounds delicious in a h...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yep... Juust looking...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, I continue on Oguri's
one-of-a-kind guided tour through a few
more places. Before I
know it, the sun
has set.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hey, the illuminations are all lit up. Now it really feels festive!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: All right, shall we head over?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There's one last thing I want to show
you. Come
on.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Okay, we're here!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
We're going to look at the stars
together.
choice_data_list: What are you going to do?
What are you going to do?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wow. Aren't they pretty? It's true the
stars really
do come out brighter in
winter.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I learned in my hometown that you can
see the
stars best this time of year.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And... the ones you can see here kind of
look the
same as the ones back home. It
makes me feel at
ease...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So... um, how was it? Did you have fun
today?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's great! So I guess my light-bulb
moment was
correct.
choice_data_list: I had a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're a grown-up, so you don't get
presents
from Santa, right?
choice_data_list: What did you come up with?
What did you come up with?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I was trying to figure out if there was
anything I could do for you. And that's
when Mayano told me that grown-ups
have their own way of celebrating the
holiday.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
She said they spend the day with
someone really
close to them.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That's when I had my light-bulb moment. I realized we're close, so maybe you'd want to spend the day with me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm glad I got it right! I really hope
today was
a nice present for you...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...! Y-you mean... Even better than a
present from
Santa?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I wasn't expecting my present to
be... that
good. It makes me feel... pretty
honored.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Okay! In that case, I'll take over for
Santa from
now, and all your presents
will come from me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So, you better get excited for it each
and every
December!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Since I celebrated like a grown-up
this
year... he might...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's not how it looks, Santa! Today was
Trainer's
present!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That should probably have it
settled, but just in case, I'm going to
write a letter and keep it
next to my
bed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Oguri Cap drops by with a
huge smile on her face and tells me she
got exactly the
present she asked for in
her letter.
